from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashPosition(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents reported in one company's filing at end of period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The cash and cash equivalents amount at end of period")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is scaled: dollars, thousands, millions, etc.")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    balance_sheet_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label used in the balance sheet")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt with the cash figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CompanyCashPosition]
